fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 47% match is a Weak Fit for this Cloudflare Egress role.

**Strengths:**
- Designed Kotlin settlement service handling about 40 million Kafka events daily
- Led 4 engineers through a 9-month monolith-to-6-services migration
- 11 years of backend work, plus Datadog monitoring and payments on-call

**Gaps:**
- No Go or Rust experience, both core to this role
- No Layer 3/4 networking, TLS, HTTP, CDN or VPN background
- No Kubernetes, ClickHouse, Grafana or Linux networking exposure

**Recommendation:** Build a Go project involving TCP or TLS networking before applying, then highlight your distributed-systems leadership in the cover letter.

coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Cloudflare

Dear Hiring Manager,

Egress connectivity only matters when it stays fast and available under constant load, and that is the problem I know from the payments side. At Lumen Payments I designed and ran the settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot, processing about 40 million events a day on Kafka, and I cut p99 latency on our payment status API from 480 ms to 120 ms by moving hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis.

I'm a backend engineer with 11 years of experience building payment and event-processing services, so owning production-critical distributed systems end to end is familiar ground. I led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services, did code review and mentoring along the way, and was on call for the payments platform, writing the post-incident reviews for 14 incidents. I also built tools and APIs, with API design as a core practice, and worked with PostgreSQL and Datadog for monitoring. My production work has been in Kotlin, Java and Python rather than Go or Rust, and I haven't worked on Layer 3 and 4 networking professionally. I'm a builder who learns quickly, and your Run What You Build model suits how I already work.

I'd welcome a conversation about how I could contribute to the Egress team's work behind WARP and iCloud Private Relay. I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer - Egress, Priya Raman
applicationEmail.body:
Hello Cloudflare Hiring Team,

You're looking for someone to own the architecture of production-critical distributed systems, and at Lumen Payments I designed and ran a settlement service that processed about 40 million events a day on Kafka, then led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to services. That mix of hands-on backend work, technical leadership and on-call ownership is what I'd bring to your Egress team. I've attached my CV and cover letter, which cover the details and my return to full-time engineering after a career break. I'm available to talk any weekday and can start with four weeks' notice.

Best regards,
Priya Raman
